note: KOA on the Needles Highway (SD-87) two miles up from US-16, in the pines between Hill City and Custer State Park - a quieter alternative to the big Palmer Gulch resort. Water/electric and full-hookup back-ins and pull-throughs plus KOA Patio sites, cabins and tent sites; heated pool in summer, food truck, lounge and dog park. The small pond by the entrance sits across the highway from the campground. --Claude
